subject: Renewal paperwork and sequencing for Q1 capacity uplift — redlines and next steps
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Dana Sokol <dana.sokol@luminex-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal paperwork and sequencing for Q1 capacity uplift — initial redline

Hi Dana —

Following up from last week's renewal calls. Luminex's team indicated a preference for a 24-month term starting 2029-01-01 with an immediate capacity uplift (Order Form #2) to cover the Q1 forecasted load. Attached is Redwood's initial redline to the MSA + consolidated order form that sequences the MSA -> Order Form -> Exhibit E (usage tiers).

Top-line items we adjusted in this version:
- Term: 24 months with an auto-renew opt-out at 90 days.
- Exhibit E: clarified token definitions for streaming vs. batch inference.
- Order form sequencing: MSA signature first, then order form countersigned; Exhibit E appended post-order-signature.
- Data retention window referenced Exhibit F; flagged for legal alignment.

Can you confirm if Luminex needs us to preserve the original SSO clause placement (we left as-is in §6.2) and whether procurement wants a single DocuSign envelope for all docs?

Attachment: Luminex_Renewal_Redline_v1.docx (tracked changes)

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

--
Redwood Inference

From: Dana Sokol <dana.sokol@luminex-analytics.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, procurement@luminex-analytics.com
Date: Fri, 3 Nov 2028 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork and sequencing for Q1 capacity uplift — initial redline

Rafael —

Thanks for sending the redline. A couple of quick items from our side after a first pass (see attached Luminex_Redline_Dana.docx):

1) Exhibit E — usage tiers: we need the burst credits definition tightened. Current language could be read to allow non-burst traffic to consume burst credits.
2) Data retention (Exhibit F) — Luminex's privacy team requests a 90-day cache retention for KV data, with a 12-month archival window. Would Redwood accept explicit carve-outs for regulated PII in the event of a subpoena?
3) Signature flow — procurement prefers a single DocuSign envelope but we need order of signatures to show MSA followed by Order Form; Exhibit E may be appended as an attachment rather than a separate DocuSign document.

We also have a few technical clarifications: is the dedicated capacity SLA reset when order form #2 goes live? Our infra team wants assurance there are no overlapping commitments.

I've CC'd Marissa/Grace for legal ops and sequencing details. Happy to hop on a 30-min joint redline session next week.

Attachment: Luminex_Redline_Dana.docx

Best,
Dana Sokol
Senior Counsel, Luminex Analytics
dana.sokol@luminex-analytics.com
+1 (617) 555-2291

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Dana Sokol <dana.sokol@luminex-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 4 Nov 2028 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork and sequencing for Q1 capacity uplift — initial redline

Dana —

Appreciate the thoughtful pass. Short answers inline and attached a clean consolidated response: Redwood_Response_Redline_v2.docx.

- Burst credits: we will tighten the definition as you requested so burst credits are only applicable to defined "burst windows" and not regular traffic. See §3.1.2 in our response.
- Data retention / PII carve-outs: we can accept the 90-day cache + 12-month archival proposal, and we propose the following language for law enforcement/subpoena requests: Redwood will notify Luminex and follow its data access process; for regulated PII we will segregate and apply requested hold procedures. Please review redline §7.4 (Exhibit F).
- SLA and dedicated capacity overlap: Dedicated capacity commitments will not reset; instead, Order Form #2 is treated as an additive allocation under the same SLA pool. We'll include a short explanatory clause in Exhibit D (Service Levels).

Proposed next steps:
1) Joint redline session (30 min) week of Nov 13 — propose Nov 13 @ 10am PT.
2) If acceptable, Redwood will prepare a single DocuSign envelope that includes the MSA and Order Form (Exhibit E as attachment).
3) Final sign-off flow: MSA (authorized signers) -> Order Form -> Exhibit E addendum.

DocuSign preview: https://docusign.com/envelope/12345-raf-lx
Drive with redlines: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_redlines_LX

Attachment: Redwood_Response_Redline_v2.docx

Thanks — I copied Ben to help coordinate procurement-level questions and Marissa/Grace for legal ops sequencing.

Rafael
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 6 Nov 2028 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork and sequencing for Q1 capacity uplift — ops note on signoff flow

Quick ops note from Legal Ops before the redline session:

- Sequence confirmation: MSA -> Order Form -> Exhibit E addendum (we'll include a cover page in the envelope that lists the order).
- Exhibit numbering: please confirm final Exhibit numbers. In our consolidated file we used Exhibit D for SLAs, Exhibit E for Usage Tiers, Exhibit F for Data Retention. If Luminex requires different labels we'll remap but keep references consistent.
- Attachments we expect to include in the envelope: Redwood_Response_Redline_v2.docx (consolidated tracked changes), finalized Order Form #2 (blank signature block), and Exhibit F (data retention clause) as a separate attachment for signers' visibility.
- Signer order: Luminex Legal -> Luminex Authorized Signer -> Redwood Authorized Signer.

For the redline session please send a calendar invite for Nov 13 10am PT and share the call notes doc ahead of time.

Marissa Cole

Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork and sequencing for Q1 capacity uplift — ops note on signoff flow

Rafael / Marissa —

Thanks to the team for the rapid turnaround and the consolidated response. After an internal alignment call, Luminex is comfortable with the tightened burst credits language and the proposed SLA additive approach.

Two remaining asks before we proceed to DocuSign:
1) Small carve-out tweak in Exhibit F for regulated PII — we will propose a one-sentence amendment that preserves Redwood's notification process but ensures retention controls for regulated data. We'll push that edit to the attached file.
2) Confirm that the single DocuSign envelope will display documents in the sequence you outlined (MSA first). Procurement prefers this for audit trails.

If both are confirmed we'll approve the redline and expect Redwood's envelope by end of day Nov 10 PT. I'm attaching our approved markup for your records.

Attachment: Luminex_approved_redline.docx
